item.tib: khrid yig dmar mo mdzub tshug
item.coloph: kho bo rang gis bstan 'gro'i spyi phan lhag bsam dkar pos dmar khrid dgongs pa yongs 'dus bskor (skor) bgyis pa'ang rnam bshad ha kyang mang song ba blo chung gi (gis) dpog dka' ba (bar) snang tshe/ rang gi slob ma g.yung drung bdud 'dul rdo rje can gyis rang re'i skyes bu gsum gyi nyams len lam rim che chung 'di la dngos gzhi rim pa bshad ma thag pa zhig dgos tshul byung ba dang*/ nye ba tshe 'di blos gtong gi ri khrod pas sangs rgyas chos 'grub kyis ((kyi) nges don khrid yig zab mo tshig gi lo ma'i dben cing don gyi sngon (snying) po la spar bzung byed pa lta bu/ phyag rdzogs dbu gsum tshig dril gyi gdams pa nyams su dang rtogs pa'i khyad par rtsa dang rlung gi nyams len thod rgal 'od gsal kyi 'char sgo dang sa dang lam gyi thob tshul bcas yod pa zhig dgos zhes nan tan gyis bskul ngor/ kho bo kun grol grags pa 'ja' tshon snying po can rang lo re gsum pa chu pho rta la hor zla gsum pa'i dkar phyogs su/ nyams rgyud kyi zhal rgyun ma 'chug pa la gzhir byas/ rnying ma bon po'i khrid yig zab rgya can nas legs cha blangs shing kho bo rang gis nyams len bltar ba dag gis bskor ba ste/ rjes 'jug sangs rgyas 'thob 'dod kyi ban bon khyed rnams legs par gzhag 'brel thong dang / bka' ni rgya che gter ni gting zab lung ni grangs mang glegs bam tshan che bshad pa tshig mang bris pa dpe mang / ngo sprod la zad pa med bslab pa la mtha' chod med bsgrub thabs dang las tshogs la 'dzad rgyu med spros bcas kyi chos la rdzogs rgyu med pas/ rgyud lung man ngag kun gyi gnad tig 'di 'dra ba bsgrub na don chen po 'grub par shes dgos so/ dang po gdams pa zab mo tshig rgyud rgya/ bar du bka' rgya grol chod 'gro don rgya/ tha ma dam ldan slob bu'i gtang bzhag rgya/ rgya gsum 'di la ma 'da' na ra kan/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ gdams pa zab mo 'di skal ldan khrid tshar slob ma bstan pa'i zhabs phyid sems can gyi 'gro don la brtse ba chen po'i lhur len pa ma rtogs (gtogs/) snyigs dus kyi ban bon lta ba kha khyer dregs po khung bcug rnams la rlungs phyogs tsam yang ma bsgrags pa shin tu nas gsang rgya dam por mdzod cig gu h+ya rgya/ i thi//
